title: mandioca dulcis
intro: Mandioca dulcis, commonly known as cassava or yuca, is a perennial plant native to South America, belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. The root of the cassava plant has been used for centuries for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its prebiotic properties. Cassava root is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of cassava root include cyanogenic glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
